topic: Demographic data requirements for UAE integration
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on gathering demographic data for the Emirates, specifically determining required fields for an integration. [p1] provided a link and confirmed that `facility_master_num` and general demographic figures are needed.

When discussing purchasing power (PP), it was noted that raw data is available only in absolute values (e.g., PPPC_CY). A suggestion was made to categorize the purchasing power into two groups (e.g., above/below 100,000).

Ultimately, it was decided to skip using purchasing power metrics for this integration.
decisions: Purchasing power data will be skipped for the current integration.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the final approach regarding demographic data with Akshay Jain.
